title: Code that types itself
blurb: A code block that holds all of its text while the canvas draws it one character at a time, with a caret, a glow and wrong keys that exist only in the picture. Selecting or copying at any moment gives the whole block.
question: Can a canvas reveal the glyphs of a code block in order while the text stays complete, selectable and copyable in the document?
result: Yes. A clip path made of character boxes over one drawElementImage() call hides the rest. Syntax colours from ::highlight() are in the picture.
